title: Pure Vaalmonica
summary: Vaalmonica cards only, with generic staples. Angello and Dimonno Vaalmonica fetch each other into the Pendulum Zones, and from there every Vaalmonica Spell and Trap lets you choose between gaining 500 LP and taking 500 damage. Each choice puts a Resonance Counter on one of the two Scales. With three counters on a Scale, the Link-1 Heathens come out: Duralume destroys a monster per counter, and Zebufera protects your cards and replays a Vaalmonica Normal Spell on the opponent's turn. The 2024 cards lead. Selettrice Vaalmonica searches a Vaalmonica card when Normal or Pendulum Summoned, Vaalmonica Invitare summons one from the Deck, and Varar, Vaalmonican Concord negates Special Summons once six counters are out. Vaalmonica Ereditare, the newest card, negates any activation while you control a Vaalmonica Link Monster.
